answer: Sybil cost compounds with each minted identity, since registration demands a vouching cycle anchored in the kernel. Two conditions keep that true. First, sponsors form a trellis: every new agent needs two independent backers who lock escrow, so a fake cluster must buy real stake. Second, admission follows a slow spiral outward, each ring weighting older kernel peers higher, so fresh sybils can't swamp the vote before trust matures.
